Turn discovery notes, scope, pricing and timelines into a clear client proposal or service SOW draft.

review: Selected unchanged for proposal, quote and service-SOW drafting. Full source gathers client needs, seller scope, pricing and timeline; writes concrete deliverables, exclusions, dependencies and commercial expectations; forbids invented statistics and unsupported guarantees. Its Australian/service-business examples and illustrative terms are examples, not approved company policy. Produces Markdown, not a legally validated contract or designed PDF.
